question: In which of the following state of India more than 85% of its net sown area is under irrigation?
solution: The correct answer is __**Haryana**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • **Haryana** is the state in India where more than **85% of its net sown area is under irrigation**. This makes it one of the most agriculturally advanced states in the country. • The state benefits from an extensive network of canals and tube wells, which ensure consistent water supply for irrigation across its agricultural lands. • Haryana is part of the **Indo-Gangetic Plain**, which has fertile soil that, coupled with advanced irrigation, supports intensive farming. • The state is a major contributor to India's **Green Revolution**, producing surplus food grains like wheat and rice. • Other states like Bihar, Odisha, and Madhya Pradesh have much lower percentages of irrigated net sown area due to geographical or infrastructural limitations.
